name: Love Fetish ~Sanshamendan Hen~
original_name: らぶフェチ　～三者面談編～
source:
Main character has a loving girlfriend, but despite all his ambition he does not know how to move forward with their relations. He asks for a consultation and finds a whole world in manipulating women around him.
